{{Quote|Today we made our most ground-breaking discovery since we arrived here two months ago. After charting the ruins in this area, our team began excavations in earnest, slowly uncovering the remains of an ancient civilization which once thrived here thousands of years ago.|Excerpt from Doctor Lancer Brunuo's journal|<ref name="aoa" />}}
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Lancer Brunou]] kept a '''journal''' in which he recorded the progress and discoveries of [[MS-133]], a [[Scientist/Legends|science]] team that served [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. Under Brunou's command, MS-133 had been sent on an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] expedition to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aaris III]] to discover what had caused the [[Death/Legends|extinction]] of the native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Aaris]]. Over the course of several [[Standard month/Legends|months]], Brunou recorded the team's progress and findings in the journal, including the discovery of an [[Plaque of Victory|artifact]] made of a metal unknown to Imperial science. Following the artifact's discovery, the team was attacked by the primitive descendants of the Aaris. Brunou was one of only two survivors of the team who were subsequently rescued from the planet by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''.

==History==
[[File:Lancer_Brunou.jpg|thumb|right|Lancer Brunou, author of the journal]]
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], commissioned a [[Scientist/Legends|science]] team, [[MS-133]], to conduct an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] expedition to a series of [[City of Kastays|ruins]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aaris III]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Lancer Brunou]] was assigned to lead the team, which had the specific remit of discovering the cause behind the [[Death/Legends|extinction]] of the [[Aaris]], the native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Over the course of a couple of [[Standard month/Legends|months]], Brunou recorded the team's progress on an almost daily basis. On day 49 of the expedition, Brunou noted that the team had found a [[Plaque of Victory|metal ingot]] in a floor safe during an exploration of a [[Place of Kastays|ruined structure]].<ref name="aoa" />

Over the next few days, Brunou recorded in the journal how tests on the artifact had revealed it was made of a substance unknown to Imperial science and that the chamber it had been found in was covered in [[Pictograph|bas-relief pictographs]]. The pictographs emitted sounds when pressed, and it was believed that they served as an aural history of the Aaris civilization. [[Grigor Tansad]] and [[Jelok]], two scientists on the team, worked on the translation of the pictographs. Despite the discoveries, Brunou noted that the team had started to become paranoid, and believed that they were being [[Spy/Legends|watched]] from the jungle, although there was no indication of sentient life on the planet. Unknown to the team was that the artifact they had discovered housed a sentient lifeform that fed off the life-force of living beings and sought to destroy them by manipulating their emotions to violence. As the team members fell prey to the artifact's influence,<ref name="aoa" /> they were attacked by the primitive descendants of the native Aaris.<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|II|154|Jelok}}</ref> The Aaris knew the artifact as the Plaque of Victory, and its influence had caused the [[Aaris civil war|downfall]] of their civilization thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] previously.<ref name="aoa" />

The team began to suffer casualties due to the Aaris' attacks, and their [[Unidentified Curich-class shuttle|shuttle]] was destroyed. Brunou and the last few survivors fortified their position and sent a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] to Sarne's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], pleading for rescue. While the team had been on the planet, Kal'Shebbol had [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|fallen]] to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and Sarne had fled into the depths of the Kathol [[Sector/Legends|sector]] with the majority of his [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]]. Brunou, along with the research assistant [[Solla Deremot]], was eventually rescued from the planet by the crew of the New Republic [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'', which had intercepted their call for help. The crew studied the journal with Brunou's permission when they investigated what had transpired on the planet.<ref name="aoa" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Lancer Brunou's journal appeared in ''[[Artifact of Aaris]]'', the second [[roleplaying game]] adventure scenario published in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' in [[1995]]. Several entries from the journal are presented in the adventure, which serves as background information on MS-133's discovery of the Plaque of Victory.<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>
